description: A Vulkan rendering engine for Minecraft, built as a companion mod to Sodium. Loads shaderpacks written in its own TOML and GLSL format.

mods.name: Fornax
mods.description: Vulkan shaderpack loader and rendering engine. Loads Vulkan-native shader packs with deferred rendering, LabPBR materials, SSAO, TAA, SSR and supersampling.

releases.notes:
# 0.4.0

## Voxels
- Face data now tracks its source per face, not per cell (fixes stale light/face data on refresh)
- Fixed vertex grid cracks at section edges
- Batch uploads reuse one buffer and fence instead of allocating each time (faster)
- Face data shrunk from 18,432 to 16,128 bytes per slot
- Model and sprite reads split from GPU upload lifetime
- Chunks now queue a harvest on arrival, so missed sections fill in without waiting on camera move

## Water
- Water prepass now draws for every water tier, not just reflection mode
- Prepass targets no longer depend on the draw gate
- Fixed cloud shadows and fluid column height scans

## World data for packs
- Packs can read the world's day count and day fraction
- Day values crossfade over real time instead of cutting at the day boundary
- Wider climate data: temperature, downfall, biome tags
- Nether fog options added
- End portal and gateway get their own slot
- Glass refraction strength exposed to terrain

## Graph engine
- Compute results reuse across frames when inputs match
- Independent passes can overlap instead of waiting in strict order
- New consolidate pass for reading several targets through one array texture
- Passes can be gated per dimension
- 3D volume textures supported for compute passes

## Debug and profiling
- GPU/CPU timings tagged by frame ID
- Profiler overlay can filter by pass, counter, or slowest only
- Can dump one frame's raw pass inputs/outputs

## Fixes
- Deferred slot reporting fixed for forward and particle paths
- Linear-filter check no longer looks at compute-only images
- Tests now pin field order in u_Globals, not just total size

## Docs
- Fixed stale mixin and test counts in AGENTS.md
- Fixed u_Globals byte size in ARCHITECTURE.md

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Icehunter/fornax/compare/v0.3.0...v0.4.0

releases.notes:
What Changed:

- page the block atlas automatically instead of behind a flag
  - the flag was off by default, so a 512x pack just failed to load with "try a lower resolution resourcepack" and nothing pointing at the switch.
  - paging only ever runs when the alternative is that failure, so there was nothing for a setting to choose.
- drop labPBR sidecars from every atlas, not just blocks.
  - entity and banner atlases were carrying 786 MB of maps nothing samples.
- size the sprite-bounds grid to the pack. 
  - a coarse grid forces a coarse placement pitch and wastes most of an overflow page. packs read it through fornax_spriteGridCell now instead of hardcoding the number.
- cap overflow pages by available memory rather than a fixed count, so a pack that will not fit refuses at load instead of swapping the machine.
- log the sprite-bounds grid size when it rebuilds the grid is resized per pack now, and nothing said what it ended up at, so there was no way to tell whether a big pack's grid was released.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Icehunter/fornax/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0

releases.notes:
Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.2 or newer, Sodium 0.9.1 or 0.9.2, and Java 25.

Fornax bundles no shaderpack. Shaders start off with none selected, so installing it
changes nothing until a pack is added and chosen. See `docs/PACK-FORMAT.md` for how to
write one.
